description: This file contains the SCSS implementation of Responsive Font Sizes (RFS) mixins and configuration variables, used for automating font resizing based on screen size, notably for responsive design in a web project.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: Mixin to calculate and apply responsive font size based on various parameters such as viewport size and specified font size.

methods.name: font-size
methods.description: Alias mixin that includes the 'rfs' mixin for setting font size responsively.
